protocol.question: Classify glycan properties/taxonomy or rank measured protein–glycan binding signals.
protocol.inputs: Glycan IUPAC tokens or glycan graphs; interaction adds ESM-1b protein sequence embeddings.
protocol.dataset_split: Taxonomy, immunogenicity and glycosylation: motif-frequency K-means cluster allocation 8:1:1. Interaction: MMseqs2 protein clusters at minimum identity 0.5 allocated 8:1:1. Exact counts are attached to each column.
protocol.adaptation: Single-task supervised training; best validation checkpoint selected from ten validations.
protocol.aggregation: Mean and standard deviation across seeds 0, 1, 2.
